BC_description: Removed support for passing writable streams to subprocess.pipeStdout(), subprocess.pipeStderr(), and subprocess.pipeAll(). Instead, use the stdout or stderr option with ['pipe', stream] for streams without file descriptors. This change fixes issues #744 and #752.
Adaptation_method: Update to use stdout or stderr options. Example: await execa('node', ['file.js'], { stdout: ['pipe', stream] }); // Instead of .pipeStdout(stream)
